title: Series opener — DRAFT, awaiting Justin's approval

cues.cap: The web should work for everyone. Every hand, every eye, every ear.
cues.say: The web should work for everyone. Every hand, every eye, every ear.

cues.cap: Most of it doesn't. Not because people don't care.
cues.say: Most of it doesn't. Not because people don't care —

cues.cap: Because nobody ever showed them how.
cues.say: because nobody ever showed them how.

cues.cap: Welcome to WCAG Learn. Let's fix that.
cues.say: Welcome to W-CAG Learn. Let's fix that.

cues.cap: WCAG is the rulebook for an accessible web.
cues.say: W-CAG is the rulebook for an accessible web.

cues.cap: Fifty-six success criteria. They can read like a legal document.
cues.say: Fifty-six success criteria. They can read like a legal document.

cues.cap: So we turned every single one into plain language.
cues.say: So we turned every single one into plain language.

cues.cap: This is WCAG Learn, the free study app.
cues.say: This is W-CAG Learn — the free study app.

cues.cap: A reference guide with real pass and fail examples for every criterion.
cues.say: A reference guide, with real pass and fail examples for every criterion.

cues.cap: Flashcards that quiz you until it sticks.
cues.say: Flashcards that quiz you until it sticks.

cues.cap: Phone or laptop, portrait or landscape, keyboard or screen reader. It works everywhere you do.
cues.say: Phone or laptop, portrait or landscape, keyboard or screen reader — it works everywhere you do.

cues.cap: And these videos? One criterion at a time.
cues.say: And these videos? One criterion at a time.

cues.cap: Learn the rule. Watch it break at our little shoe store.
cues.say: Learn the rule. Watch it break at our little shoe store.

cues.cap: Test for it yourself. Then fix it, and prove the fix.
cues.say: Test for it yourself. Then fix it — and prove the fix.

cues.cap: A couple of minutes each. No jargon. No filler.
cues.say: A couple of minutes each. No jargon. No filler.

cues.cap: Fifty-six criteria. Fifty-six videos. Start anywhere.
cues.say: Fifty-six criteria. Fifty-six videos. Start anywhere.

cues.cap: The web gets better one fix at a time. Let's go.
cues.say: The web gets better one fix at a time. Let's go.
